name: Kohinata Sumomo
source:
Sumomo is [url=/c10382]Yuuma[/url]'s younger sister who seems to have an energetic personality. She has amazing cooking skills. She has known [url=/c10383]Haruhi[/url] since childhood and they used to play together. Due to family circumstances, Sumomo didn't become Yuuma's sister until after she had entered elementary school. She is not a blood-related sister for Yuuma. 

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Happiness!#Characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
